title: Source authority, security and GitHub publication
summary: Use Alchemy's canonical Autobuild submission: source package tree, tests and integration.json in immutable branch; ready.json committed last; accepted source appears on main only via receiver.
invariants: Keep private node.env, MI registration keys, H test keys, peer secrets, host keys and cloud credentials out of Git.
Do not confuse a submission branch with accepted mainline source or a live deployment.
Keep XTP dev25 integration source and the Grid dev18-compatible RTO2 repair distinctly versioned.
Respect F/H commissioned identities and segregate H-local test authority from production admission.
